references.text: The Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthah as preparation for the battle against the Ammonites
A similar expression is used concerning Othniel: The Lord gave their enemy into his hand
The Lord promised to give the Midianites into Gideon's hand, the same promise fulfilled here
Jephthah refers back to this victory when the Lord gave the Ammonites into his hand
David confesses that the Lord grants victory in battle, not by sword or spear, but by the Lord's hand
The Lord gave their enemy into the hands of the Israelites when they cried out to him in battle
The Lord promised to give King Sihon into Israel's hand, using similar language about God's help in war
Jephthah is mentioned among the witnesses of faith who by faith won victories in war
